title: Weeknote #2021
content:
I'm not updating my personal Mac so this isn't relevant to me but this script turns off all the Apple Intelligence shit on MacOS and gets the model space back.

I did link to this post from Cory but it's worth linking again now — this is like the sabotage field manual for the modern web.

Crawler Zoo is fun.

Blake made his own Solitaire game and I got distracted for a lot longer than I should when he linked it.

Da Vinci, the guy who totally "invented" the helicopter, drew some legged penises in his sketchbook. Inside every man there is a burning desire to draw knobs.

I wanted some new coloured pencils and I ended up down a rabbit hole of comparisons and information about who manufactures what for who. This comparison was my gateway drug starting point. I landed on this Melifluo/Brutfuner set.

This recreation of the Commodore 64 keycap font is perfect.

This AI generated copy of the Abode suite is certainly something to watch if only to see how long it lasts.

This person hired an artist to draw their house and now they're using it for their home assistant dashboard and it's cool as fuck.
